purpose: Owner/review-gated binding of the two primary tower cable-node elevations A/C and their four anchors each onto the five source-resolved Pad004 shaft side faces.
validation_rules: Exactly four anchors must be bound at WT-A and exactly four at WT-C.
The source shaft has five side faces, therefore a four-anchor level cannot silently imply that all shaft faces are used.
Node_Z_m must remain inside the source Pad004 shaft range 13.3..68.3m; WT-C must be above WT-A under the current owner topology.
Selected shaft faces must be explicit. Whether the same or different face is excluded at A and C is an owner/review decision, not a geometry inference.
Face_Local_u is constrained to [-1,1], where zero means geometric face midline; zero is not a default and cannot be inserted without owner/engineering evidence.
Anchor XYZ may only be derived after Node_Z_m, Selected_Shaft_Face_ID and Face_Local_u are explicit.
Target_Node_or_Pole_ID remains null until the cable endpoint pairing is explicitly attributable.
Geometric nearest-face diagnostics may inform review but cannot populate structural edge targets automatically.
